reviews.review:
This is really a religious experience for VR. You're being told the story of Joseph from the Old Testament / Torah / Quran. It's mostly cinematic, however, there are some interactions. Most of it is in English, however, other parts were I believe in Turkish and maybe even some Arabic. 

You can walk around the scene while the narrator goes over the story. However, while the game looks okay overall, there are some parts that look misplaced (as though certain assets were from an asset store). The game mostly automatically takes you to the next scene. When this happens, it feels like the game is going to crash as the visuals go haywire.

However, for some scenes, you're supposed to do something (like walk to a certain area). In the scene where Jacob  was first arriving in Egypt to get adopted by his slave owners, the game would not progress. I tried everything I could think of. Nothing would progress. I'm not sure if it was a bug or if I missed something.

The experience is just too rough around the edges for me to have enjoyed it. I'm not doing a video because if I did, it would show how bad the experience truly is, even though certain parts look good. I cannot recommend this experience, unless you're a religious zealot. You may be able to overlook the flaws.
